description: Land Acquisition - Panagamuwa and Ihalagoda, Akmeemana D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, extents, and locations. The content falls squarely within the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals with land acquisition matters, property descriptions, and compensation procedures related to real estate.
